products.title: Holsten Premium Pilsner
products.description: Medium gold colour; light hop & cooked grain aromas with underlying pear notes; clean finish

products.title: Kilikanoon Killerman's Run Shiraz
products.description: This Shiraz is Kilikanoon's idea of an entry-level wine. Some introduction! A hedonistic pleasure, it's plush with apricot and black plum jam, floral lift and mixed berries fruit. A bold match for barbecued spareribs, spicy sausage pizza or grilled hanger steaks.

products.title: Gloria Ferrer Blanc de Noirs
products.description: Very pale pink tinge. This has an intriguing, evolved nose that incorporates ripe red berry fruit with plenty of toasty-yeasty autolytic character, moist barley, toasted almonds and wildflower honey. The palate is full, rich and creamy, with a vague impression of sweetness but impressive depth and length overall. This is a bold and satisfying, powerful yet balanced bubbly from Sonoma, with superior depth and concentration. Score - 91. (John Szabo, MS, winealign.com, May 3, 2017)

products.title: Yalumba Organic Viognier 2021
products.description: A splendid expression of the variety showing apricot, mango, potpourri and orange peel aromas, followed by a concentrated palate displaying richly textured mouthfeel and beautifully pitched acidity, offering awesome drinking. At its best: now to 2025. Score - 94. (Sam Kim, wineorbit.co.nz, Sept. 2021)

products.title: Canadian Club Whisky
products.description: The legend of Canadian Club began in 1858 and grew to become one of the world's most iconic whiskies. Pouring a medium gold you will find aromas of roasted almond, vanilla and pepper; with spicy vanilla, cornflakes and a faint nutty flavour on a medium weight palate with a long finish.
